95727.overview:
The Berenstain Bears' A School Day is an Educational game, developed by Realtime Associates and published by Sega, which was released in 1995. Join in the excitement as the Berenstain Bears have a busy day at school. Children will learn the alphabet and create words by recognizing letters. Objects and animals will come to life as your children match and learn shapes and put them in their place. Using characters from the story and their own original art, your children will create and animate their own cartoons. Dot-to-dot games teach numbers and letters!

Identify objects and create the word!

Learn your ABC's and catch the letter!

Plant and water your garden with nimble fingers!

An easy video game develops dexterity!

Create and animate your own cartoon!

147027.overview: Denji Sentai Megaranger (電磁戦隊メガレンジャー) is a Sega Pico game based on the Denji Sentai Megaranger television show.

147028.overview: Densha Daishuugou! is a Sega Pico game themed around the Diapet range of model trains.

147029.overview: Disney Princess Suteki ni Lesson! Hiragana Katakana is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Sega Toys, which was released in Japan in 2004.

147030.overview: Disney Princesses: Ariel is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Sega Toys, which was released in Japan in 2004.

147031.overview: Disney Princesses: Princess ni Naritai! is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Sega Toys, which was released in Japan in 2003.

147032.overview: Do Re Mi Fa Densetsu is an educational game for the Copera. The Mixt Book Player Copera is a special brand of Sega Pico console developed by Yamaha (under license from Sega) and released in Japan in late 1993.

147033.overview:
Donald no Obake Taiji (ドナルドのおばけたいじ) is a Sega Pico game based on the Donald Duck franchise.

Though only released in Japan, plans were put in place at one stage to bring the game to Germany as Donalds Gespensterjagd. A prototype German ROM has since been released, and hints that it was due for release in 1995.

147034.overview: Donald no TV Show (ドナルドのテレビショー) is a Sega Pico game released exclusively in Japan.

147035.overview: Doraemon: Chiiku Asobi Doraland (ドラえもん 知育あそび ドラランド), is a Sega Pico game based on the Doraemon franchise.

147036.overview: Doraemon: Eigo de Asobou ABC (ドラえもん えいごであそぼう ＡＢＣ), is a Sega Pico game based on the Doraemon franchise.

147113.overview:
Musical Zoo, known as Do Re Mi Fa Animals no Tanoshii Ensoukai in Japan, is a Sega Pico game. There's a Zoo-full of animals ready to take your children on exciting musical adventures! They'll hop, fly, splash, waddle and buzz their way to uncover your child's hidden talents! Explore the world of instruments, notes, scales and more by playing wonderful musical games. With the help of animal "toons" from the story, your children will create and animate their own songs and melodies. Enjoy the world of music with a Zoo-full of animal teachers!

Test your musical ear with fun games!

Explore different instruments and their sounds!

Feel the beat as you discover tempo and rhythm!

Recognize notes and learn scales!

147152.overview:
Disney's Pocahontas Riverbend Adventure is described as storyware and it based on the 1995 animated Disney film. It offers several activities in the universe of the Indian princess:
Music: create your own tunes to make Pocahontas dance.
Geometry: create pottery using different shapes.
Coordination: a little arcade game with a canoe on the river, Pocahotas should doge objects.
Pairing: find different clothes to recreate Percy's suits.
Drawing/count: use the pico pen to link numbered dots to reveal a picture.

147222.overview:
Disney's The Lion King: Adventures at Pride Rock is based on the 1994 Disney animated film. It offers several activities in Simba's universe:
Use memory skills to create a picture with puzzle pieces.
Uncover a picture and learn your ABC.
Match and learn shapes and put them in their place.
Count stars in the sky and learn numbers.
Develop your dexterity in an easy arcade mini-game

147408.overview: Dance Pico: Hashitte Odotte Chou Happy! is a Sega Pico game package containing a Dancing mat and the game Hashitte Odotte Chou Happy! (はしっておどって超ハッピー！) , which was not sold separately.

147411.overview: Doraemon no Utatte Pico: Issho ni Utaou! Doraemon Waku Waku Karaoke (ドラえもんのうたってピコ いっしょにうたおう！ ドラえもん わくわくカラオケ) is a Sega Pico Karaoke software. Two types have been released in the presence or absence of peripheral.

147412.overview: Doubutsu Pico: Hamster Land is a Sega Pico package containing hamsters toy and the game, which was not sold separately.

147414.overview: Saa Shuppatsu da! Ken-chan to Pepe no Wanpaku Drive (さあしゅっぱつだ！ ケンちゃんとペペのわんぱくドライブ) is a Sega Pico package containing a handle controller Drive kit and game, which was not sold separately.
